meeting_title: City Council Meeting, January 14, 2025
transparency_notes: Meeting date and title taken from the printed header (pages 180-187; Council President John M. Walsh, Jr.). The header states "Eleven Councilors Present," and the three officer/appointment roll-call votes list all 11 councilors by name: Alinsug, Chakoutis, Field, Hogan, LaPierre, Matul, McClain, Meaney, Megie-Maddrey, Net, and Walsh. No councilor is recorded as absent at the meeting's start. However, one later vote (New England Auto Detailing, 8 Bennett Street) was recorded as "10 YES 0 NO (Councilor Meaney ABSENT)," so Meaney appears to have been absent for that item despite the opening attendance count of 11 — this is transcribed exactly as printed and not reconciled. The three officer/appointment elections (President, Vice-President, Water & Sewer Commission appointment) were candidate votes where all 11 councilors named the same choice; the document records these as "11 Votes = [name]" rather than a yea/nay tally. They are represented here as 11-0 to reflect unanimity, but the source did not phrase them as YES/NO. Committee report acceptances (Public Safety & Public Health, Licensing, Veterans) were accepted without a recorded numeric tally; individual license outcomes (Granted/Tabled) within the Licensing report are transcribed as printed. Minor apparent OCR/typographical issues in the original headings (e.g., "Council Appointment to him Lynn Water and Sewer Commission") are noted but not corrected. This is the 2025 council term; several names (Walsh, Chakoutis, McClain, Meaney, Net) reflect that term and were transcribed exactly as printed, not assumed from the 2026 roster. Document attested "A True Copy" by City Clerk Janet L. Rowe.
